about: Task 21: the calibration half judged by the protocol, in its reading order. The design before any outcome (D1's contrast, the blocking decision, the MDE80 of reports/design.json re-printed); the outcomes; per variant the effect T, E_m per match and every cell, the pre-trend P in sd and metres, the permutation p and the calibration bar, with the variance factor 1 / (1 - r^2) of G and x as a diagnostic; V0 with the ball detected at both ends and the V2 classes beside them, deciding nothing; D1 to D5, mechanical. No threshold is moved. Definitions in ac2fb.defence.calibration, ac2fb.defence.effect and protocol/protocol.json.
